item.title: Ohio Minimum Wage to Increase January 1, 2026
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio’s minimum wage will increase at the start of the new year, rising to $11 per hour for non-tipped employees and $5.50 per hour for tipped employees on January 1, 2026, according to state officials.
